scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path='dist/vikunja-super-productivity-plugin-package'; fs.mkdirSync(path,{recursive:true}); for (const file of ['manifest.json','icon.svg']) fs.copyFileSync(file, path + '/' + file)" && esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/vikunja-super-productivity-plugin-package/plugin.js
scripts.package: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const fixed=new Date('2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'); for (const file of ['dist/vikunja-super-productivity-plugin-package/manifest.json','dist/vikunja-super-productivity-plugin-package/icon.svg','dist/vikunja-super-productivity-plugin-package/plugin.js']) fs.utimesSync(file, fixed, fixed); fs.rmSync('dist/vikunja-super-productivity-plugin-0.1.2.zip', {force:true})" && zip -X -FS -j -q dist/vikunja-super-productivity-plugin-0.1.2.zip dist/vikunja-super-productivity-plugin-package/manifest.json dist/vikunja-super-productivity-plugin-package/icon.svg dist/vikunja-super-productivity-plugin-package/plugin.js
